First Jaywan cards delivered to Wio Bank
Marks entry into UAE’s national card scheme, signaling potential volume growth.
Shows existing capacity can serve Gulf demand without new capex.
National schemes can shift issuance volumes from global networks.
Geographic expansion can diversify revenue mix and pipeline.

This is an early-stage commercial milestone in AUSTRIACARD’s MEA expansion and national scheme support strategy. A larger catalyst would require disclosed issuance volumes, additional issuer wins, or revenue impact tied to Jaywan deployments.
